### 1. Classification of Bacteria based on Temperature

| Type | Optimum Temperature Range | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Psychrophiles** | $< 15^\circ\text{C}$ (Cold-loving) | *Psychrobacter*, *Polaromonas* |
| **Mesophiles** | $20^\circ\text{C} - 45^\circ\text{C}$ (Moderate) | *Escherichia coli*, *Lactobacillus* |
| **Thermophiles** | $45^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ (Heat-loving) | *Thermus aquaticus* |
| **Hyperthermophiles**| $> 80^\circ\text{C}$ (Extreme heat) | *Pyrococcus furiosus* |

### 2. Bacterial Diseases and Causative Agents
1. **Tuberculosis:** Caused by *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*
2. **Cholera:** Caused by *Vibrio cholerae*
3. **Typhoid:** Caused by *Salmonella typhi*
4. **Tetanus:** Caused by *Clostridium tetani*
5. **Diphtheria:** Caused by *Corynebacterium diphtheriae*
proTip: Memorize optimum temperature ranges clearly as examiners frequently ask to differentiate between psychrophiles, mesophiles, and thermophiles.
